messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: action lifecycle & exec asks (crossfunc sync)

Team —

Quick follow-up from today's cross-functional sync. We're three weeks out from the scheduled QBR with Acme and I want to lock the action lifecycle so exec asks don't slip into the final week. High level asks below; please update the tracker (attached) with owners and completion ETA by EOD Wed 5/12.

Priority items (short):
- Pricing exception for R&D sandbox seats (Acme asks for 20% off list for pilot) — need final position for the QBR. (Owner: Aditya)
- SLA deviation request for KV cache retention (Acme needs 90-day log retention for audit) — legal + infra input required. (Owner: Vivek)
- Demo script: include new batching performance numbers and fallback behavior. (Owner: Karthik)
- Replaceable prompt examples — product wants a curated set for the exec deck. (Owner: Marissa)

What I need from each owner: 1) short status, 2) blockers, 3) one-sentence recommended resolution for the exec (decision-ready). I will consolidate and send an exec-ready brief on Fri 5/14.

Attachments: QBR_action_tracker.xlsx (sheet with current asks), SLA_exception_request.pdf (Acme's ask).

Thanks,
Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Programs | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: action lifecycle & exec asks (crossfunc sync)

Vanessa —

Quick status on the demo script and perf numbers:
- Batching perf: latest continuous-batching patch improves 95th pct latency by ~120ms at 512-token load (test harness attached to tracker). I recommend we call out the latency improvement and show a short gif in the deck.
- Fallback behavior: default route -> cheaper quantized variant is functional; still need a smoke on Dedicated pool before we mark as "production ready." Blocker: Dedicated smoke window opens Fri 5/14 and we need infra sign-off. (Owner: Jonas to confirm infra window)

Action: I'll draft the demo script by Wed EOD and add a short note on fallback tradeoffs for the exec brief.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior PM, Serving & Platform

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: action lifecycle & exec asks (crossfunc sync)

Vanessa —

SLA exception (KV cache retention): initial assessment below.
- Feasibility: 90-day retention is possible but adds storage and throughput implications for the cache: estimated incremental cost ~6–8% on the serving cluster.
- Compliance: Legal confirms we can expose retention controls; requires an audit log surface which we currently don't persist beyond 30 days.
- Recommendation for exec: offer a timeboxed pilot with a 60-day retention default and an optional 90-day pilot tied to a cost-share (Acme covers incremental infra for pilot). If exec prefers to absorb cost, we can propose that as well.

Attached: short cost delta and a draft SLA exception request. I flagged this as needing Aditya's ok for commercial concessions.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | VP Engineering, Serving Runtime
Attachment: SLA_exception_request.pdf

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: action lifecycle & exec asks (crossfunc sync)

Thanks — quick clarifications from Acme's side: 
1) The 20% pilot discount is a hard ask for our procurement; without it the pilot will be strictly limited to a single product team and won't represent company-wide adoption.
2) For the retention pilot, Acme can cover up to 50% of the incremental infra costs during the pilot but needs a clear rollback plan and audit evidence at the end.

We can be flexible on the structure, but procurement needs a one-page term sheet by Fri 5/14 to review ahead of their approval cycle.

—Priya
Priya Shah | Head of Cloud Partnerships, Acme Analytics
priya.shah@acmeanalytics.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeanalytics.com>, procure@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: action lifecycle & exec asks (crossfunc sync) — consolidated actions (final)

Team — thanks for the fast turn. Consolidated updates and my asks for the exec brief: 

1) Pricing exception (Aditya) — status: I need a clear commercial position. Options: a) approve 20% pilot without revenue commit (fast), b) approve 20% pilot conditioned on a 6-month committed usage threshold, or c) decline and offer a restricted pilot (single-team). Please reply with recommended option + one-liner rationale.

2) SLA retention (Vivek) — status: proposed 60-day default + 90-day pilot with partial cost-share. Ask: confirm pilot-run telemetry (who captures audit evidence), and whether legal can accept a temporary exception clause. Naomi/legal to confirm.

3) Demo script (Karthik + Jonas) — status: Karthik to add script; Jonas to confirm Dedicated smoke window Fri 5/14. If smoke succeeds, include a brief video clip in the deck.

4) Prompt examples (Marissa) — status: curate top 5 use cases and one blocker: we need to sanitize customer PII. Ask: Marissa to share sanitized examples by Thu 5/20 for final deck.

Next steps: I'll produce an exec-ready one-pager and slide appendix by Mon 5/17 EOD. If anyone expects to miss their EOD Wed 5/12 update in the tracker, flag now — I will escalate.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz | Head of Customer Programs, Redwood Inference
Attachments: QBR_action_tracker.xlsx (updated)
